# statuspage_user_permissions (Resource)

Manages Statuspage user permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = statuspage_user_permissions.example
  id = "org123/user-id-1"
}

resource "statuspage_user_permissions" "example" {
  organization_id = "org123"
  user_id         = statuspage_user.example.id

  pages = {
    "page_id_1" = "manage"
    "page_id_2" = "view"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String)
- `pages` (Map of String) Map of page_id to permission level.
- `user_id` (String)
